'''''The Last of the Jedi: Dark Warning''''' is the second in a series of young reader novels that chronicle the adventures of [[Ferus Olin]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] during his exile following [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].
